TTP Trader, next version · 2026-10-29 · pick one direction for a ~2.5 h Opus build at 13:45 EDT

TODAY: the Ghost Sheep Trader is a Trader row on the Barn button's fan while he is at the hedge (one 6 h visit per pig per local day, seeded 08 to 22 in the feeding zone). His sheet is the bag with a price on every tile: 3 / 8 / 20 applied tickles by rarity, the fancied find ×2, six per visit, never snouts (app_settings.trader_tuning; trade_with_trader; trader_sales is the ledger).

RULES EVERY DIRECTION KEEPS: no new currency · the trader never pays snouts · bought items are never convertible · finds are given, never sold (a swap mints nothing) · the fan is the one door · tokens, painted glyphs, no em dashes.

Each row: arrival on the fan · the sheet · the confirm · the receipt · the leave. Boards link in Play (tap the Trader row or the ticket). Art is the real trader frames, find glyphs, Rosie idle_1, Pepper as the friend's pig.

tA.text: A · Ghost Sheep v2: sets and trade-ups

sA.text:
A · Ghost Sheep v2: sets and trade-ups

WHAT: he still buys singles (3/8/20, fancy ×2). New: a PAIR pays half again (two alike handed over in one visit), and THREE ALIKE trade up one rarity (3 → 1, his seeded pick of which; rare has no trade-up). The bag of six grows to nine so a hand can actually form.

PILLAR: Collect (holding becomes a reason; a dead-end stack becomes a step up). Contend: none. Connect: none, honestly.

CHARTER CHECK: no new currency (applied tickles only) · never snouts · paid items untouched (finds only) · finds given-never-sold stands (trade-up is finds for a find, a 3→1 sink, never a faucet) · one sentence: 'pairs pay more, three alike go up'.

SERVER: trader_tuning gains {pairMultiplier, tradeUp:true}; trade_with_trader judges a pair over the visit's trader_sales (no multi-select RPC needed); NEW trade_up_with_trader(find_id, nonce): delete 3 rows, insert 1, ledger kind='trade_up'; satchel cap 6 → 9 in satchel tuning. One migration, two RPCs.

CLIENT: TraderSheet gains the hand strip + a trade-up ticket state + the lilac 'came back' receipt; hook: one new mutation; fan sub-line.

BUILD: 2.5 h fits IF pairs are judged server-side over the visit and flushes are deferred. Migration 45m · sheet 75m · tests 30m. Risk: the bag cap change touches the Satchel sheet's empty slots.

tB.text: B · The roaming broker: he carries a friend's wish

sB.text:
B · The roaming broker

WHAT: on arrival he is carrying ONE sounder-mate's rolled wish (seeded: a mate whose wish you can fill from your bag; else nobody, and he trades as today). You send the find and take one of up to three spares the server picks from her biggest stacks (the barn swap's own rule), or just give it. The sheet shows his route today (seeded arrival order across the herd), so 'he was at Maya's 2h ago' is a text message.

PILLAR: Connect first (a specific friend's want, carried to you), Collect (a lone digger meets a rare), Contend ('N swapped' on the Board already counts it).

CHARTER CHECK: no new currency · never snouts (he carries, he never pays; the flat 3 tickles each is the delivery the barn swap already pays) · finds move 1:1 and mint nothing · one swap per pair per UTC day reuses the swap cap · nothing bought is ever involved.

SERVER: trader_status() gains carrying {friend, wish, spares[]} via _peek_wish + _wish_options; NEW broker_swap(nonce, give_item_id, take_find_id|null) wrapping the barn swap's transfer path with the trader as the courier; route = sounder-mates' trader_visits for the day ordered by arrival (read-only). One migration, two RPC changes, no new table.

CLIENT: a 'He carries' section + spare picker + route strip on TraderSheet; a landed-delivery toast; the Satchel's swaps tab lists the courier.

BUILD: 3.5 to 4 h. Does NOT fit 2.5 h whole. B-lite (carry the wish, GIVE only through the existing swap RPC, no spares, route line only) is ~2.5 h and keeps the Connect beat.

tC.text: C · The seasonal wanderer: Old Wisp folded into the Ghost Sheep

sC.text:
C · The seasonal wanderer

WHAT: on a seasonal week (Hallows first) the same visitor goes by Old Wisp, dusk tint on the yard, and ADDS one ask a day: a named earned wearable or find. Hand it over and he leaves a seasonal keepsake (a Barn furnishing, 7 per set, the set closes with the week). He still buys finds for tickles underneath.

PILLAR: Collect (a set with an end, keepsakes hang in the Barn), Connect (friends swap spare wearables to fill each other's asks; the 10-14 ruling).

CHARTER CHECK: keepsake = furnishing, not a currency · never snouts, never tickles for a wearable · paid items NEVER convertible: an ask only ever names earned pieces, provenance checked server-side, bought pieces shown locked · finds given-never-sold unchanged. CAUTION: spending a wearable consumes it; the permanent-unlock promise needs the instance ledger before this is real.

SERVER: wearable instance ledger + mint provenance backfill (the big one), seasonal_asks(user, local_day, item), redeem_seasonal_ask(nonce) granting via grant_habitat_item, swap_wearable(friend, give, take); seasonal window in app_settings.

CLIENT: dusk yard, Old Wisp name/greetings, ask card + keepsake reveal + set row, friend swap entry.

BUILD: 8 to 12 h. Not today. C-lite (ask for a FIND, pay a keepsake via grant_habitat_item, no wearables) is ~2.5 h but drops the wearable loop that makes it Old Wisp.
